commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
90+4' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
90+2' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the top right corner, but Julen Agirrezabala is alert and thwarts the effort.
90+1' Tactical foul in the middle of the pitch interrupts the opponent's attacking opportunity. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sets up the ball and will be the one to take this free kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar.
85' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle after Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Oscar Valentin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' A cross by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
78' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Oscar de Marcos provided an assist for the goal.
77' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
76' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

74' Here is a change. Isi Palazon is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
74' A substitution has been made. Pathe Ciss goes off and Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
72' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.
69' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Nico Williams plays it into the box, and Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
65' Substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) in, Randy Nteka out.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Inaki Williams as he is replaced by Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao).
64' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Adrian Embarba will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
63' The referee awards a corner and Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take it.
63' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Julen Agirrezabala.
60' Augusto Batalla blocks Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao)'s effort from the edge of the box.
59' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
59' A cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
57' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Mikel Jauregizar and he is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
56' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Inigo Lekue is replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gorka Guruzeta departs the field of play to be replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Alvaro Garcia darts into free space to control the ball.
52' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) fires a volley from the edge of the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
51' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Julen Agirrezabala is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). Easy save!
46' Referee Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
43' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner.
42' A long pass, executed by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
40' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't beaten the offside trap again.
38' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.

36' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
35' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
33' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
32' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
31' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
30' The corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla.
28' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
27' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
26' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
26' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Ath Bilbao will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
19' The corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
19' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
11' The linesman raises his flag. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
8' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla easily deals with the threat.
6' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
